_about: One row per HUD element. All drawn by the plugin with its own shapes and a system font; no MORDHAU art or fonts. anchor: screen position as fractions of width/height. shows: the state it reads. hook: row id in hooks.json.

rows.shows: player stamina / max; flashes on stamina_out
direction the next swing will take (swings.id)
rows.style: small tick around the dot at the swing angle

rows.shows: successful parry or chamber this frame

hide Skyrim's crosshair; hide Skyrim's health and stamina bars ONLY while MORDHAU's own bars are drawn (sheets/builds.json mordhau_bars 1) - with those off (the default since 0.1.7) Skyrim's bars are the only ones and stay
